# RAID log

Track risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies in one place. Review weekly.

## RAID table

| Type | Item | Likelihood | Impact | Owner | Next step | Due date | Status | Links |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Type: Risk, Assumption, Issue, Dependency.

## Notes

- Every entry needs an owner and a next step.
- When a risk becomes real, reclassify it as an issue.
- Dependencies should include what happens if the dependency is late.
